observation: API has 5 lexical keys; dataset has 50 numeric feature candidates plus categorical/text fields.
consequence: Direct model plug-in is not valid without an explicit shared contract.

observation: API uses len(url); recorded URLLength often differs (section 6.2).
consequence: Same-name mapping would silently change the measurement.

observation: API uses case-sensitive startswith("https"), not parsed HTTP(S) scheme.
consequence: Validation and scheme normalization must be defined in shared extraction.

observation: Backend treats prediction 1 as phishing; source label 1 is legitimate.
consequence: Role 2 must explicitly recode target or adapt serving interpretation.

observation: When model is absent, heuristic words/dash produce a prediction and fixed confidence values.
consequence: These values are not measured model probabilities or calibrated confidence.

observation: Current extractor does not retrieve page content or redirects.
consequence: Content-dependent training features are unavailable to this extractor.
